title: Modified component CartLine to ask before removing an item
context: A click on Remove in the cart took the item out of the cart at once, with no step to back out of. The cart now asks the shopper to confirm, and names the product in the question. The item leaves the cart only when the shopper confirms.

- **When** a shopper clicks Remove on a line of the cart, **then** [the browser asks "Remove <product name> from your cart?"](code:src/routes/cart/components/CartLine.tsx#L10) and the item is still in the cart.
- **When** the shopper confirms the question, **then** [the item leaves the cart](code:src/routes/cart/components/CartLine.tsx#L10), as it did after one click before.
- **When** the shopper cancels the question, **then** the item stays in the cart and the total stays the same.
- **When** a shopper clicks "Empty the cart", **then** nothing changes: the cart summary still opens its own dialog.

- Added [`handleRemove()`](code:src/routes/cart/components/CartLine.tsx#L9-11), a function inside `<CartLine />` that [calls `removeItem(item.product.id)` only when `window.confirm()` returns `true`](code:src/routes/cart/components/CartLine.tsx#L10).
- Modified [the Remove `<Button>`](code:src/routes/cart/components/CartLine.tsx#L18-20) to pass `handleRemove` as `onClick`. It passed `() => removeItem(item.product.id)` before.

journeyFlowDiagram.title: A shopper clicks Remove on a cart line

nodes.label: Asks for confirmation before it removes the item
nodes.description: **The change.** [`handleRemove()` calls `window.confirm()` with `` `Remove ${item.product.name} from your cart?` ``](code:src/routes/cart/components/CartLine.tsx#L10), and it calls `removeItem(item.product.id)` only when the result is `true`. [The Remove `<Button>` passes `handleRemove` as `onClick`](code:src/routes/cart/components/CartLine.tsx#L18), where it passed `() => removeItem(item.product.id)` before. [`removeItem` is the action that `<CartLine />` reads from `useCartStore`](code:src/routes/cart/components/CartLine.tsx#L7), so without the condition one click takes the item out of the store.

nodes.label: Renders one cart line per item
nodes.description: Unchanged. `<CartPage />` [reads `items` from `useCartStore`](code:src/routes/cart/index.tsx#L6) and [renders one `<CartLine />` per item with the prop `item`](code:src/routes/cart/index.tsx#L11-13). It is on the path because no other component renders `<CartLine />`, and the `item` it passes holds the `product.name` of the question and the `product.id` that `removeItem()` takes.

contract.before: Takes `{ item: CartItem }`. Renders an `<li>` with the name, the quantity, the price and a Remove button. A click on Remove calls `removeItem(item.product.id)` of the cart store at once.
contract.now: The same props and the same `<li>`. A click on Remove calls `window.confirm()` first, and calls `removeItem(item.product.id)` only when `window.confirm()` returns `true`. A parent that passes `item` sees no change.

waypoints.title: Modified `<CartLine />` to confirm before it removes an item
waypoints.reading:
The author modified a component `<CartLine />` that:

- declares a function `handleRemove()`, which calls `window.confirm()` with `` `Remove ${item.product.name} from your cart?` `` and calls `removeItem(item.product.id)` only when the result is `true`
- passes `handleRemove` as `onClick` to the Remove `<Button>`, where it passed `() => removeItem(item.product.id)` before

A click on Remove now takes the item out of the cart only after the shopper confirms, and a cancel leaves the cart as it is. [`<CartPage />` renders one `<CartLine />` per item](code:src/routes/cart/index.tsx#L11-13) with the prop `item`, and `<CartLine />` still takes that prop and no other. `removeItem` in `src/stores/cart-store.ts` is unchanged: it drops the item whose `product.id` it is given.
